# [TASK] Audit the 3 services and frontend bugs

## Task
Audit the 3 services and frontend bugs with `/audit-artifacts`: shape, voice, truth, proof.

Bugs in service registration, service configuration and frontend tests.

Scope: #69, #132, #228.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Bug #69 audited: matches the bug template, meets the writing standard, its fix and regression criteria each name a proof, and severity, priority label and body agree
- [ ] Bug #132 audited: matches the bug template, meets the writing standard, its fix and regression criteria each name a proof, and severity, priority label and body agree
- [ ] Bug #228 audited: matches the bug template, meets the writing standard, its fix and regression criteria each name a proof, and severity, priority label and body agree

## Estimate
**Hours:** 4

## Notes
Bugs have no parent section by design. Do not add one.

A bug's "Fixed and verified live" criterion is the one most likely to rest
on a date. Replace it with the regression test that would catch the bug
coming back, and write that test if it does not exist.
